english.note: Use 捱得耐過 B when saying that someone will survive or remain alive longer than B, usually in a comparison.

examples.english: I think I’ll outlive him, so I won’t have to bury him first.
examples.traditional: 我諗我捱得耐過佢，唔使我埋佢先。
